H7228.d: by contraction from רָבַב; (or perhaps the same as רַב); an archer; archer.

H7416.d: or רִמֹּן; from רָמַם; a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament); pomegranate.

H7397.d: probably feminine from רָכַךְ; softness; Rekah, a place in Palestine; Rechah.

H7263.d: from an unused root meaning to pile together; a lump of clay; clod.

H7328.d: (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning; to attenuate, i.e. (figuratively) hide; a mystery; secret.

H7284.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָגַשׁ; to gather tumultuously; assemble (together).

H7010.d: (Aramaic) from קוּם; an edict (as arising in law); decree, statute.

H7201.d: from רָאָה; a bird of prey (probably the vulture, from its sharp sight); glede. Compare דָּאָה.

H7104.d: from קָצַץ; abrupt; Keziz, a valley in Palestine; Keziz.

H7454.d: from רָעָה; a thought (as association of ideas); thought.

H7173.d: the same as קַרְקַע; ground-floor; Karka (with the article prefix), a place in Palestine; Karkaa.

H7087.d: a primitive root; to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water); congeal, curdle, dark, settle.

H7481.d: a primitive root; to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger); make to fret, roar, thunder, trouble.

H7325.d: a primitive root; to slaver (with spittle), i.e. (by analogy) to emit afluid (ulcerous or natural); run.

H7202.d: from רָאָה; seeing, i.e. experiencing; see.

H7298.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to hollow out; a channel or watering-box; by resemblance a ringlet of hair (as forming parallel lines); gallery, gutter, trough.

H7009.d: from קוּם; an opponent (as rising against one), i.e. (collectively) enemies; substance.

H7445.d: from רָנַן; a shout (for joy); joyful (voice), singing, triumphing.

H7141.d: from קָרַח; ice; Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites; Korah.

H7240.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to רִבּוֹ; {a myriad, i.e. indefinitely, large number}; [idiom] ten thousand times ten thousand.

H7152.d: plural of קִרְיָה; buildings; Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine; Kerioth, Kirioth.

H7026.d: or קֵרֹס; from the same as קַרְסֹל; ankled; Keros, one of the Nethinim; Keros.

H7060.d: a primitive root; to wither; hew down, wither.

H7494.d: from רָעַשׁ; vibration, bounding, uproar; commotion, confused noise, earthquake, fierceness, quaking, rattling, rushing, shaking.

H7051.d: intensive from קָלַע; a slinger; slinger.

H7389.d: or רֵאשׁ; or רִישׁ; from רוּשׁ; poverty; poverty.

H7041.d: from קָלָה; insignificance; Kelajah, an Israelite; Kelaiah.

H7462.d: a primitive root; to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend); [idiom] break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, [phrase] shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.

H7488.d: from an unused root meaning to be green; verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous; green, flourishing.

H7302.d: from רָוָה; sated (with drink); drunkenness, watered.

H7188.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) unfeeling; harden.

H7095.d: from קָצַב; shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off); bottom, size.

H7315.d: from רוּם; elevation, i.e. (adverbially) aloft; on high.

H7456.d: a primitive root; to hunger; (suffer to) famish, (be, have, suffer, suffer to) hunger(-ry).

come to pass that when they shall be hungry

H7143.d: from קָרַח; bald; Kareach, an Israelite; Careah, Kareah.

H7497.d: or רָפָה; from רָפָא in the sense of invigorating; a giant; giant, Rapha, Rephaim(-s). See also בֵּית רָפָא.

H7044.d: from קָלַל; brightened (as if sharpened); burnished, polished.

H7103.d: the same as קְצִיעָה; Ketsiah, a daughter of Job; Kezia.

H7299.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to רָאָה; aspect; form.

H7399.d: or רְכֻשׁ; from passive participle of רָכַשׁ; property (as gathered); good, riches, substance.

H7425.d: from an unused root and יָהּ (perhaps meaning to deck); Jah has bedecked; Remaljah, an Israelite; Remaliah.

H7196.d: from קָשַׁר; an (ornamental) girdle (for women); attire, headband.

H7276.d: from רָגַם; stoneheap; Regem, an Israelite; Regem.

H7258.d: from רָבַץ; a couch or place of repose; where each lay, lie down in, resting place.

H7034.d: a primitive root; to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt); base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.

H7132.d: from קָרַב; approach; approaching, draw near.

H7464.d: feminine of רֵעַ; a female associate; companion, fellow.

H7444.d: intensive from רָנַן; shouting (for joy); singing.

H7054.d: feminine of active participle of קוּם; something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain; (standing) corn, grown up, stalk.

H7469.d: probably from רָעָה; a feeding upon, i.e. grasping after; vexation.

H7318.d: from רָמַם; exaltation, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise; be extolled.

H7336.d: a primitive root; probably to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) honorable; prince, ruler.

H7477.d: a primitive root; to reel, i.e. (figuratively) to brandish; terribly shake.

H7294.d: the same as רַהַב; Rahab (i.e. boaster), an epithet of Egypt; Rahab.

H7160.d: a primitive root; to push or gore; used only as denominative from קֶרֶן,; to shoot out horns; figuratively, rays; have horns, shine.

H7216.d: or רָאמֹתxlit Râmôth corrected to Râʼmôth; plural of רָאמָה; heights; Ramoth, the name of two places in Palestine; Ramoth.

H7343.d: the same as רָחָב; proud; Rachab, a Canaanitess; Rahab.

H7189.d: or קֹשְׁטְ; from an unused root meaning to balance; equity (as evenly weighed), i.e. reality; truth.

H7246.d: a primitive root; to soak (bread in oil); baken, (that which is) fried.

H7013.d: from קוּן in the original sense of fixity; a lance (as striking fast); spear.

H7406.d: from רָכַס; a mountain ridge (as of tied summits); rough place.

came to pass on the fourth

H7021.d: perhaps from קָיָה; the gourd (as nauseous); gourd.

H7446.d: from רָסַס; a ruin (as dripping to pieces); Rissah, a place in the Desert; Rissah.

H7398.d: from passive participle of רָכַב; a vehicle (as ridden on); chariot.

H7067.d: from קָנָא; jealous; jealous. Compare קַנּוֹא.

H7072.d: for קַנָּא; jealous or angry; jealous.

H7049.d: a primitive root; to sling; also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms); carve, sling (out).

H7474.d: feminine of רֵעַ; a female associate; fellow, love.

H7353.d: from an unused root meaning to journey; a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller); ewe, sheep.

H7118.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to קְצָת; {a termination (literally or figuratively); also (by implication) a portion; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after}; end, partly.
